findings.description: The KMS key does not have enable_key_rotation set (defaults to false), as the in-file comment confirms. Without rotation, the same customer master key encrypts data indefinitely, weakening the cryptographic guarantees over time and violating the secure key management and CIS key-management controls that mandate rotation for symmetric KMS keys.
